semantic_contract.task_statement: Find the intersection of two sorted arrays.

result.canonical_semantics: Intersection elements common to both sorted arrays.

semantic_contract.human_review_instruction: Judge the original generated pseudocode against this same frozen task-semantic contract, including when automated evaluation is NOT_EVALUABLE.

declared_evidence_summary: This suite provides core behavioural evidence for a representative sorted-array intersection, an empty-input boundary and disjoint sorted arrays. Unsorted input is observed separately as a semantic-boundary probe.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on 3 core Common Test cases plus any separately declared semantic-boundary probes; boundary probes do not contribute to core behavioural accuracy.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret core behavioural accuracy as evidence within the frozen semantic contract. Interpret Semantic Boundary Variance separately as descriptive evidence of out-of-domain acceptance.
coverage_limitations: The core suite now exercises empty and disjoint sorted arrays. Unsorted input is outside the stated sorted-array contract and is reported separately as semantic-boundary variance.
